facts: 3rd race yellow fleet.
1st attempt was done with uniform flag and the RC raised a general recall.
2nd attempt was done with Black flag, the RC within the last minute postponed the start raising AP due to wind shift and current affecting the starting line.
After displaying AP the RC displayed a board with 226874, 8416, 5619, 3092, 5334, 9386, 8355
On the board the RC displayed the full sailing number of the 1st boat (226874) but all the other number were displayed only with the last 4 digits.
GER 219386 saw the board and thought that all the other 4-digit numbers listed on the board were beginning with 22.
GER 219386 did compete and finish race 3.
GER 218355 did not see the board on the RC vessel and did compete and finish race 3.
GER 225619 & GER 215334 did compete and finish race 3.
At the 3rd attempt the RC successfully started with clear starting line.
The RC removed the board after the successful start.
GER 218416, GER 223092, GER 226874 did not start in race 3
